About

The eye behind
the edit.

I'm Deepak — a video editor and graphic designer based in Chennai, India. I turn raw footage into cinematic stories and raw ideas into striking visuals — from reels that stop the scroll to graphics that make brands feel alive. With a sharp command of industry-standard editing and design tools and a deep fluency in AI-assisted workflows, every project I deliver is a step above ordinary.

Process

How the magic
gets made.

01
Brief & Vision
We start with your story — your goals, audience, and the emotion you want to leave behind. Every great edit starts before the timeline.
02
Rough Cut
I assemble the narrative structure — pacing the story with intention, letting the best moments breathe and the weak ones go.
03
Color & Sound
Color grading in DaVinci Resolve brings the visual language to life. Sound design locks the emotion in place. This is where it becomes cinematic.
04
Deliver & Scale
Final exports optimized for every platform — from 4K master files to compressed social cuts. Ready to publish, share, and impress.
